summary: Flat stretch of quiet residential street with homes about 11-13 m away.
reasons: Homes 11-13 m away on this side
Quiet street, a few cars parked

best_section.where: On the straight run south-west of the bend, past the boat driveway

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 11-13 m from the kerb, with more homes across the road. No bush or park backing it.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a few cars parked along it; room to pull in at the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Quiet local street; a main road runs about 100 m to the west.
drivers.convention: Ordinary residential kerb with some parked cars and a boat; no camping convention.

flags: Steep elsewhere: up to 17% between 130 and 200 m
sun_shade: Mixed tree cover from the east and north-east; open to afternoon sun from the west.
